title: Emkusiously Enchanced
description: Client side Mods for performance and immersion
body:
A client side modpack that haves various performance, visuals and quality of life mods, shaders, and texture packs.

**Performance**
This modpack haves alot of performance mods to provide you speed benefits on your device and to faster boot into the game to experience minecraft

**Visuals**
This modpack includes visuals like custom particles, effects, texturepacks, animations and more

**Quality of life**
Quality of life mods include fast switching between blocks and tools, inventory sorting, moving while in the inventory and others
